episodes.synopsis: The Block Finals for Selection Project, an idol competition show, are about to begin, and Suzune Miyama is ready to take the stage!
episodes.title: Only One Yell

episodes.synopsis: Suzune, still dismayed by the results in the finals of the selections, receives a surprise visit from Seira. Hoping to cheer her up, Seira takes her around town, but Suzune discovers she might not be ready to sing again yet.
episodes.title: The Girls on a Journey to Tomorrow

episodes.synopsis: The hopeful idols, now accommodated in the dorm, split into three teams to face a direct confrontation in the first round. Suzune's partner however doesn't seem very interested in working with her...
episodes.title: If Singing Vanished From the World

episodes.synopsis: It's the dance team's turn to shine! But tensions rise when the passionate Hiromi takes charge, and the other members cannot keep up. They need to work together to perfect their routine and create a catchy name.
episodes.title: Rush, Crash, Splash

episodes.synopsis: The Band will be the last to play, but there is a problem: they are not ready. Uta wants to do it at once and Shiori wants to polish her bassline, what will gentle Mami Mako do?
episodes.title: Ecstatic Troublemakers

episodes.synopsis: Round 2 starts with an announcement: it's a swimsuit round! Everyone is excited to go to the beach and get some screams, except Suzune, and no one but Rena seems to know why.
episodes.title: Her Heart, Her Hidden Secret

episodes.synopsis: With Suzune threatening to drop out, the other eight idol candidates team up to bring her back to the group. A conversation with Rena and a letter from a fan might be what inspires her to continue.
episodes.title: Feelings in Naked Blue

episodes.synopsis: The final judging task is to show off the original songs by the seven selected people. It was revealed that the two people who will drop out will be decided by voting among the members, The nine people who have deepened their relationship are terribly upset.
episodes.title: The True Tone of Her Heart

episodes.synopsis: The heart of the legendary idol, Amazawa Akari, is in Suzune's chest ...! Rena's heart sways in the shocking facts. Her interview progresses, and her intentions for the nine dropouts gradually solidify ...
episodes.title: My Self in the Seashell

episodes.synopsis: The results of the selection vote of the final examination are complete, and the members who will finally drop out have been decided. A program that welcomes the development of turmoil. And the members who returned to their hometown also started a certain project.
episodes.title: I Just Want to Sing

episodes.synopsis: Nine people who restarted as an idol group "9-tie". I want to deliver our songs without anybody missing I started a live performance on the street, but it didn't go as I expected ...
episodes.title: One Little Step at a Time

episodes.synopsis: If you win 2 million ales in the live broadcast that made your debut, The dream of becoming an idol as "9-tie" comes true! As each of them got excited, something happened to her body ...
episodes.title: The Feelings We Want You to Know

episodes.synopsis: A light that pushes Suzune's back. Sunny reveals the secret of the light to Rena. A companion who believes and waits for two people. Will the final live with the idol debut succeed? Whereabouts of the battle for dreams ...?
episodes.title: Our Glorious Days
